title: RTEC Equal Employment Opportunity / Affirmative Action policy statement lineage

features: EEO implementation assigned to Sheila Stallsworth.
Retains goals/timetables, shared management responsibility, complaint rights and Sheila Stallsworth assignment.
Near-lineage historical EEO/AA language retained outside annual AAP folders.
Contains genetic-information protection in its EEO/AA section and Sheila Stallsworth assignment.
Broader protected-class wording including sex with gender identity, sexual orientation and pregnancy.
Explicit disability/religious reasonable-accommodation commitment absent undue hardship.
Executive Director overall accountability plus designated EEO Officer/Manager.
Current direct-reporting and complaint-investigation assignment for the EEO Officer.
Shared implementation responsibility for executives, management and supervisors.

durable_structure: Executive Director retains overall accountability for EEO.
A designated EEO role manages implementation/monitoring/complaint investigation.
Management and supervisors share implementation responsibility.
Employment actions are covered by nondiscrimination policy.
Applicant/employee complaint rights are recurring across the policy lineage.
Affirmative-action/EEO program materials are retained for inspection/reporting and workforce-goal analysis.
changes_over_time: Protected-class wording becomes more explicit/broader in later policy generations.
Later sources add explicit anti-retaliation and reasonable-accommodation statements.
Named EEO role holders change across the historical series and must always be resolved by effective date rather than copied forward from an older AAP.
The newest signed 2026 source supersedes the 2025 handbook's officer assignment while preserving substantially similar core nondiscrimination language.
source_quality_note: Historical policy sources contain references to federal/state authorities and terminology as printed. Preserve those statements as historical policy text; do not silently update statutory/regulatory references in the archived source.
